# GitHub: Ishaan Verma (@ishaanverma)

## Profile
- Name: Ishaan Verma
- Account type: User
- Bio: Python developer. Scrapers, small APIs and automation.
- Location: Jaipur, India
- Website: https://ishaanverma.example.dev
- Followers: 57, following: 40
- On GitHub since 2021-04-09 (about 5 years)

## Totals
- Public repositories: 12
- Original repos: 11, forks: 1
- Stars across original repos: 64
- Languages by number of original repos: Python (8), JavaScript (2), Shell (1)
- Repos with a description: 9/11, with topics: 5, with a live homepage link: 1
- Engineering practice (checked 12 repos): tests in 4, CI in 3, Docker in 2

## Top repositories (3, ranked by stars, recency and substance)

### 1. price-tracker-api
- Description: FastAPI service that tracks product prices from scraped pages and sends alerts when a price drops.
- Language: Python, stars: 24, forks: 3, license: MIT
- Topics: fastapi, scraping, price-tracking
- Last push: 2026-09-05 (1 month ago), created 2025-02-20, size 420 KB
- Detected: tests yes (17 test files), CI yes (GitHub Actions), Docker yes, docs yes, manifests: pyproject.toml
- README excerpt:
> # price-tracker-api
> Add a product URL, pick a target price and get an email when it drops. Scrapers run on a schedule; results are stored in SQLite.
> Run `docker compose up` to start the API and the worker.

### 2. jaipur-bus-scraper
- Description: Scrapes city bus timetable pages into clean JSON.
- Language: Python, stars: 15, forks: 2
- Topics: scraping, transit
- Last push: 2026-03-11 (7 months ago), created 2024-11-02, size 96 KB
- Detected: tests yes (5 test files), CI no, Docker no, docs yes, manifests: requirements.txt

### 3. inbox-sorter
- Description: Automation script that labels emails by rules in a YAML file.
- Language: Python, stars: 9, forks: 0
- Last push: 2025-10-14 (1 year ago), created 2025-04-30, size 40 KB
- Detected: tests no, CI no, Docker no, docs no, manifests: requirements.txt

## Other original repositories
- dotfiles [Shell], 4 stars, pushed 2026-09-20
- portfolio-v1 [JavaScript], 3 stars, pushed 2024-05-12: A first personal site
- quote-widget [JavaScript], 2 stars, pushed 2023-12-02
- …and 5 more small Python scripts

## Recent public activity
- 71 public events over about 90 days, most recent 2026-10-06 (2 days ago)
- 33 pushes (58 commits), 5 pull requests opened (1 to another person's repo), 4 PRs merged, 2 issues opened, 3 PR reviews

## Technologies mentioned across repos
Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Docker, GitHub Actions
